Individual uplift predictions

Source: R/uplift.R
uplift.Rd

The predicted mean response with the treatment set to its treated value minus the prediction with it set to the control value, for each row: the individual uplift (conditional average treatment effect) of a model with treatment by covariate interactions.

Usage

uplift(object, treat, newdata = NULL, treated = NULL, control = NULL)

Arguments

object

A fitted model.

treat

Name of the treatment variable (0/1, logical or a two level factor).

newdata

Optional data (default the model data).

treated, control

Values of treat for treatment and control (default 1 and 0, or the second and first factor levels).

Value

A numeric vector of uplifts.

Examples

set.seed(1); n <- 400
d <- data.frame(t = rbinom(n, 1, 0.5), x = rnorm(n))
d$y <- rbinom(n, 1, plogis(-0.5 + 0.3 * d$x + d$t * (0.2 + 0.8 * d$x)))
f <- regcomp(y ~ t * x, family = "bernoulli", data = d)
u <- uplift(f, "t")
qini(u, d$t, d$y)
